_note: What Buzz says on the What is this? page, one speech bubble per entry, in order. Players tap Next to move through them. You can use bold and italics in the text. The last bubble's button says lastButton and goes to lastLink.
bubbles: Hi! I'm Buzz. I love spelling bee but I got tired of high all the high scores and bad subway wifi so I made my own version.
Each daily puzzle has a max score of 120 and <emph>never</emph> needs an internet connection.
But then I started thinking... and realized I really just want to get pangrams and maybe some hints sometimes what's wrong with that?
So I made a Puzzle mode where you can solve harder and harder pangrams and get hints in the form of Justin's drawings.
But then I started thinking, I should really be compensated for my work.
So now you can earn Buzz Bucks for solving puzzles and use them to buy me new outfits!
But then I started thinking, man this would be more fun with gambling...
So I made a Pangramble mode where you can wager your Buzz Bucks on whether you can solve a pangram quickly.
So that's all you need to know. Happy Birthday Sharon and have fun buzzing!
